title: Bank outage reports spike: JPMorgan says issues are resolved, blames internal software bug for transaction delays
content_md: David Hollerith and Grace O’Donnell report: Reports of problems with banking apps and payment services surged across major US banks Monday, though several institutions said their systems were operating as usual while some customers experienced transaction delays. Customers’ reports of issues spiked across a number of sites, including those for JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America… Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/11/16/bank-outage-reports-spike-jpmorgan-says-issues-are-resolved-blames-internal-software-bug-for-transaction-delays/
exclude_reason: Banking app and payment delays blamed on an internal software bug; an availability incident with no attack, vulnerability, or data exposure.
